checks.name: Sprint has both Shift bindings and held-state polling
Shift cannot move or animate gameplay behind main menu
Run state uses valid Humanoid rig without root motion
Existing walking remains 4.5 metres per second
Left Shift selects Run and reaches seven metres per second
Run animation cadence follows retargeted stride length
Running actually animates the leg bones
Releasing Shift returns to walk speed and animation
Shift alone never runs in place
Right Shift also runs
Diagonal sprint is normalized
Sprint faces the actual movement direction
Sprint cannot tunnel through a wall
Blocked movement returns animation to idle
Dodge takes animation priority over sprint
Sprinting keeps the original three-metre roll
Sprint does not shorten the dodge animation
Held Shift resumes running after dodge recovery
Releasing Shift during dodge resumes walking
Pause freezes sprint position clock and animation
Holding Shift through resume restores sprint
Attack interrupts sprint and holds the player still
Held Shift can resume running after attack
Death disables sprint input and movement
Running never accumulates displacement on the visual root
